claims.statement: All three synthetic strategies are feasible with no constraint violations and increasing area raises margin but also waste, so a larger plan remains permissible despite shortfall.

All three synthetic strategies are reported FEASIBLE with empty constraint lists, yet the Lean strategy leaves a fill rate of 0.443 and a shortfall of 606.02 kg, so feasibility here means absence of hard resource/timing violations rather than acceptable demand coverage.
Across all feasible strategies, higher area and harvest show progressively higher fill rates with modest waste, consistent with lead-time constraints rather than resource violations.
Scaling area from 120 to 240 m2 doubles harvest (662.0 to 946.0 kg) while margin only increases from 2594.58 to 3193.15 SGD, implying diminishing returns beyond Lean.

All three strategies are reported FEASIBLE with empty constraint lists, so no hard resource, timing or inventory violation is currently identified; the Lean plan still leaves a fill rate of 0.443 and shortfall of 606.02 kg, which is an allowed honest shortfall rather than a feasibility blocker.

All three synthetic strategies have empty constraint lists and are FEASIBLE, but the Balanced and Resilient plans are the only ones with fill rates above 0.5, leaving Lean with a large 606.02 kg shortfall; this is a demand coverage gap, not a hard feasibility violation.
